title: Primal pulled-back module base change
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-picard-pullback-base-change, the canonical base-change map for the pulled-back module E is invertible for every h.

proof.text: Apply the finite-locally-free unit theorem to N at g and to h* N at h ≫ g. Finite local freeness of h* N follows from the proved Modules.isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback instance (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.FiniteDescent), transported by Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq from abstract pullback to tensorPullback.

Paste the two pullback squares with IsPullback.paste_horiz and use isoPullback to identify their iterated pullback with pullback f (h ≫ g). Construct the pushforward equivalence along this scheme isomorphism from pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr and pushforwardId. Its adjunction unit is invertible. The composite-unit formula and unit_conjugateEquiv_symm transport the unit isomorphism from the single pullback to the iterated pullback.

Take the adjoint of h*η_p followed by moduleBaseChangeMap at p* N. Naturality of homEquiv and its inverse cancel the defining transpose. Apply Mathlib unit_conjugateEquiv_symm to the pushforward-square isomorphism and the two composite adjunctions: the result equals η_p′ followed by the pushforward of the pullback-comparison isomorphism. Both units and the comparison are invertible, so cancellation proves invertibility of moduleBaseChangeMap at p* N.
Apply moduleBaseChangeMap_naturality to the supplied isomorphism e. All functor images of e are invertible, so cancellation transports the result from p* N to the pulled-back E.

theorem picard_pullback_base_change_primal {X S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hO : ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : T' ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g'))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T'.ringCatSheaf)))
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S) (N : T.Modules) [N.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (e : Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E ≅
      (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj N))
    {T' : Scheme.{u}} (h : T' ⟶ T) :
      IsIso (Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
        pullback.condition ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E))
